patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Basecamp and Linear share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Basecamp and Linear share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Basecamp only if your buying job matches “Opinionated simple project hub (to-dos, message boards, chat, docs) — Free; Pro from $15/u” rather than Linear's shape. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than Basecamp's shape. Workflow advantage: Basecamp leans team-collaboration-work; Linear leans work-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Basecamp and Linear share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Basecamp is Opinionated simple project hub (to-dos, message boards, chat, docs) — Free; Pro from $15/user/mo; Pro Unlimited $299/mo flat.; Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Basecamp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Basecamp-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Linear-leaning work-management.
- Researched limits: Basecamp — Not a deep Work OS / portfolio planner; Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS.

Limitations — Basecamp: Not a deep Work OS / portfolio planner; Minimal native automation; Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise.

Poor-fit cases: Basecamp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a deep Work OS / portfolio planner · Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · Avoid Basecamp if you actually need Linear's motion (Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
